t: Tightening Up vs. Making Less Brittle: A Developer's Ikigai
s: This article explores the tension between deepening developer craft ('tightening up' one's Ikigai) and the inherent brittleness of technological platforms. It advocates for building resilient workflows by focusing on transferable skills and open-source alternatives, thus making mastery antifragile against external dependencies.
sub: Developer Ikigai framework for aligning craft with passion, skill, income, and need.
Critique of proprietary software and 'walled gardens' leading to workflow brittleness and dependency risks.
Advocacy for open-source tools, open standards, and embodied skill mastery (muscle memory) for antifragility.
Analysis of the Netflix business model as an example of innovations lacking sustainable competitive moats.
Defining craft as embodied muscle memory, akin to musicians and athletes, vulnerable to tool changes.
